title: Convert deep research into decision-ready synthesis infrastructure
objective: Normalise the five-source research into an evidence-linked comparative matrix, pattern atlas, anti-pattern atlas, and machine-readable taste dimensions without promoting any external expression into Mez truth.

included: Seven cross-source mechanisms and eight research questions
Problem, evidence, mechanism, transfer, exclusion, confidence, originality, and experiment mappings
Unapproved taste dimensions for later human calibration
excluded: Canonical token, component, or brand-rule promotion

acceptance: Humans can compare every mechanism, evidence basis, risk, and experiment without opening all source files
LLMs and validators can consume the same seven mechanisms and all eight research questions
Cross-source mechanisms are separated from source signatures, failure modes, and promotion gates
Category clichés, current Mez risks, exceptions, repairs, and tests are explicit
At least eight unapproved dimensions can drive controlled human preference testing

verification.passCondition: All TR-4 files, fields, evidence links, research questions, and unapproved states pass.
The five deep source dossiers remain valid.
No matrix or atlas entry copies a source expression or promotes a source value into Mez.

stopConditions: Stop any row that cannot resolve to source evidence IDs.
Keep every taste dimension and candidate experiment unapproved.
Do not begin preference calibration or visual directions inside TR-4.
notes: TR-4 prepares the decision system. TR-5 is the next human calibration block.
